notes: Cold means an empty Cargo target directory; operating-system file caches are not cleared.
Reset rebuilds restore the baseline between every incremental measurement and are reported separately.
Preparation invokes Git and copies files, but never invokes Cargo or accesses the network.

limitations: Cold means an empty Cargo target directory; registry and OS caches were retained.
Cold has one sample per snapshot; warm and each incremental scenario have three samples.
Incremental probes repeat the same literal edit, retaining prior incremental states; reset rebuilds are excluded from medians.
These are local compile-check measurements; other edits, machines, background activity and CPU frequency can change elapsed times.
Application startup, rendering, model latency and runtime memory are not measured.
Raw logs, timing HTML and frozen sources are local ignored artifacts referenced by relative paths.
